defectsFoundAndFixed.mechanism: Pixel budget was read from getBoundingClientRect(), which follows CSS transforms. During the modal zoom-in (scale 0.2->1) under load the first measurement landed below the density floor, and ResizeObserver (layout box only, transform never re-fires) left the failed state permanent. Deterministically reproduced with a scaled ancestor (measured 196 of 340 layout px).
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Measure the transform-immune content box (clientWidth), matching ResizeObserver content-box semantics.
defectsFoundAndFixed.regression: QRCode.test.tsx DOM test: scaled rect 238 with layout clientWidth 340 must still reach ready

defectsFoundAndFixed.mechanism: Compact locators gained relayEd25519 and endpointTlsTrust leaf SPKI pin; the live payload is 368 chars at QR v15 (77 modules). The 280px box yields 3px modules, which an independent decoder rejects at v15 for both peers and classic styles; >=4px (340px / 85 columns) decodes. The shipped 280px test fixture omitted the new fields and stayed at 251 chars, so the regression was not caught.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Modal 400px, code stage 340px, constraints minModulePixels 4 (dense payloads now fail loudly instead of rendering undecodable codes).
defectsFoundAndFixed.regression: prepare.test.ts uses the production-shaped 368-byte reference: decodes at 340/4px and rejects 280px under minModulePixels 4 with PAYLOAD_TOO_DENSE

harnessNotes: The device-link runtime intentionally pauses polling while document.hidden is true and refreshes on visibilitychange. A never-activated acceptance window stays hidden, so the real macOS window must be fronted before scanning; this is product-correct (the compare-code UX requires a visible desktop), not a product defect.
UiAutomator2 instrumentation survives app force-stop; stale sessions on systemPort 8290/8291 must be cleared before a new Appium session.
